# Overview

This document describes how to build, test, publish, and run the **CONTENTO** Docker image.

## Prerequisites

Before starting, ensure that:

- Docker Desktop is installed and running
- You have a GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) with permissions to publish packages
- The project directory contains:
  - `Dockerfile`
  - application source code
  - `inst/` data directory

Verify that Docker is available:

```bash
docker --version
```

# Navigate to the Project Directory

Docker builds from the current directory (`.`). Move into the directory containing the `Dockerfile`.

```bash
cd /path/to/contento
```

# Build a Local Test Image

Build a local image for testing and debugging. Use the `--no-cache` option to ensure a fresh build. 
Save the build logs to `build.log` for later inspection.

```bash
docker build --no-cache -t contento-test . 2>&1 | tee build.log
```

## Verify Local Image

```bash
docker run \
    --rm \
    -p 3838:3838 \
    -v $(pwd)/inst:/srv/shiny-server/app/inst \
    contento-test
```

Then open a web browser and navigate to `http://localhost:3838` to verify that the application is running correctly

# Build the Production Image

Build the image using the GitHub Container Registry tag.

```bash
docker build -t ghcr.io/klemonlab/contento:latest .
```

## Understanding the Image Name

```text
ghcr.io/klemonlab/contento:latest
│       │         │        │
│       │         │        └── Tag
│       │         └──────── Repository
│       └────────────────── Organization/User
└────────────────────────── Registry
```

The `latest` tag is used as the default production release.

## Authenticate with GitHub Container Registry

Load the GitHub Personal Access Token stored in `.bash_env`.

```bash
source .bash_env
```

Login to GitHub Container Registry:

```bash
echo "$CR_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u IsabelFE --password-stdin
```

Successful authentication should produce: `Login Succeeded`


## Push the Image

Upload the image to GitHub Container Registry.

```bash
docker push ghcr.io/klemonlab/contento:latest
```

## Pull the Image

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/klemonlab/contento:latest
```

# Run the Application

Launch the Shiny application:

```bash
docker run \
    --rm \
    -p 3838:3838 \
    -v $(pwd)/inst:/srv/shiny-server/app/inst \
    ghcr.io/klemonlab/contento:latest
```
